_rules: Fixpoint, undervoice 16127: a row appears only with TWO independent statement readings; 'proved' never appears; NARROWER rows quote lean/docs on what is missing. Readers are listed by who read the Lean statement against the paper, sub-agents counted with the seat that verified them.

rows.title: Complete Crouzeix, constant 2, any Hilbert space
rows.lean: the complete (matrix-coefficient) Crouzeix bound with constant 2 for every bounded operator, plus sharpness
rows.gap: none at the statement level; the contour calculus's else-0 branch is excluded by the conclusion

rows.title: Abhyankar-Sathaye and stable coordinates
rows.lean: for every n >= 4 an F with C[x]/(F) = C[n-1 variables] that no automorphism makes a variable; and an explicit degree-5 f, a coordinate after adjoining one variable, not in four
rows.gap: none for the collection's claims; docs/049: the three-variable case is not covered

rows.title: Triangular cylinders cover a tetrahedron for under half
rows.lean: a small-epsilon family of 2 ceil(2/eps^2) cylinders covering the regular tetrahedron at total cost below 1/2 of the shadow
rows.gap: regular tetrahedron and 'sufficiently small' eps with an unspecified O(eps^4) constant; the paper's corollary covers every tetrahedron

rows.title: A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound
rows.lean: an unbounded sequence of n with n-point sets whose triangles all have area >= n^(-2 + 1/(100000 K))
rows.gap: docs/191: 'the linked construction is for an unbounded sequence of sizes; the paper's statement for every sufficiently large n is broader'

rows.title: Pure point spectrum for the 2D Anderson model
rows.lean: almost surely the 2D Anderson operator with uniform disorder on [-h, h] has spectrum [-4-h, 4+h]
rows.gap: docs/261: 'It does not assert the pure-point spectral type claimed in the accompanying paper' (nor the paper's d >= 3 weak-disorder a.c. claim)

rows.title: The log-Brunn-Minkowski inequality
rows.lean: |K|^(1-t) |L|^t <= |log-combination| for origin-symmetric convex bodies in every dimension n >= 1
rows.gap: none at the statement level (the full origin-symmetric BLYZ problem, all n); the 24,490-line proof is the kernel's word

rows.title: At most three mutually unbiased bases in C^6
rows.lean: no 6 mutually unbiased orthonormal bases of C^6 (Attainable n -> n <= 5), plus a Fourier vanishing lemma for order-6 Hadamard matrices not equivalent to Tao's
rows.gap: docs/266: 'does not establish the paper's upper bound of three'. Still strong: n <= 5 rules out a complete set of 7 in dimension 6. Prior claim of that (Joka, arXiv 2511.03537) rests on an open MUB-to-Latin-squares step. 3,381 modules kernel-checked, no native_decide

rows.title: A counterexample to the small Cohen-Macaulay conjecture
rows.lean: there exists a 3-dimensional complete Noetherian normal local C-domain with residue field C
rows.gap: docs/195 says the MCM-free property is not proved. Sharper: the existential is met by C[[x,y,z]], which is regular and IS its own maximal CM module, so the statement does not pin the paper's candidate at all

rows.title: An Artin group that is not CAT(0)
rows.lean: an explicit Artin group on 116 generators (labels 2, 3, infinity) has no geometric action on any nonempty proper CAT(0) space
rows.gap: none at the statement level (docs/254 states exactly this); the 9,400-line proof is the kernel's word
